_heapMB_note: MEASURED AFTER A COLLECTION since 2026-08-06 — livecheck now forces gc before sampling, so this is LIVE memory, not whatever the collector had not reached. The old 380 was calibrated against the un-GC'd number, which on this build flips between 307 and 391 with nothing changed and refused two deploys at random. Settled heap is 218MB. 260 leaves ~40MB of headroom and would still catch a real regression; against the ~206MB iOS ceiling the island is already about 12MB over, which is the honest position and is tracked rather than hidden by a loose budget.
